title: API endpoint file
description: `api.json` in the cache folder of the working copy (`<OS cache>/logreq/<sha256 of the absolute workspace root>/`, ADR-0008): where the running local API of `logreq serve api` listens, and its token (ADR-0009). Written at start with mode 0600; a client reads it and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The API listens on loopback only (SR-079). A file left behind by a stopped API names a port nobody listens on.

token.description: 256 random bits, base64url without padding; new at every start.

urls.description: Base URLs, one per loopback address the API listens on (`::1` only where the machine has IPv6).

pid.description: Process ID of the API. While it runs, a second API for the same working copy asks the URLs before it starts; when it does not run, the file is stale and is replaced.
